verdicts.reason: A gets the hierarchy wrong: the attribution is set in heavy, widely spaced caps and wraps onto two lines ('AIKO TANABE, / ARCHITECT'), so it competes with the quote. The quote leaves 'move.' alone on its last line, the oversized logo is the focal point, and there is a large dead gap between the quote mark and the text. B keeps the attribution small and subordinate on one line, but it sits jammed under the quote and runs almost to the right edge. The quote is small next to the dominant logo, and the bottom ~150px is empty. These flaws are fixable, while A's hierarchy is broken.
